game.name: Katana ZERO
game.rules:
Timing starts on the first bullet deflect in Factory (gaining control) and ends on the fade to black after the retinal scanner.

Runs must be done with the speedrun mode.
Show Timer option must be On.
The whole timer must be fully visible for the duration of the run.
Please leave *Time* empty and only fill in *In-game time*, and make sure to also include the 2 decimal digits.
Show the run summary that shows up at the end of the run.

Mods of any kind are not allowed, with the exception of the music files.

All runs require a video. Please clip the video to the start of the run you are submitting with timestamps either in the link or in the description.

Sound FX must be audible.

If submitting using a Twitch link, please use Highlights instead of VODs. VODs are automatically deleted after a certain period of time.

Rapidly swapping between controller inputs and keyboard inputs in order to gain an advantage is banned.

Using a third party application to rebind the mouse wheel to an in-game keybind, or to bind more than two keys to a single input, is banned.

Quitting out to the main menu is **not** allowed.

Low quality submissions may be rejected at moderator discretion on a case by case basis if the run is difficult to watch/verify (Extremely high screenshake, low bitrate, etc).

The save icon (blue floppy disc which occasionally appears on the bottom right corner of the screen) must be visible.

Both intentionally abusing version 1.0.6 double rolls and using reset run for Bunker 1 IL to skip the half second cutscene are banned.

The entire run must be shown. You cannot edit out, omit, or obscure any footage, including time spent on the pause screen and screen transitions. Alt-tabbing during the run is not allowed if it causes the recording to freeze or depict a screen other than the game's.
